author: Mr_Vortex_123
body:
Good after noon,

I have just found this server on the internet and put the ip adress in Minecraft, as you do, and have been greeted a message saying:

BANNED

You have been punished by Media

awesome_apricot for Advertising on April 14, 2014

4:27:59 PM GMT

As I said, I only got this server today and do not account of being banned. Please could someone solve this issue and respond back to me.

Thanks

Mr_Vortex_123

title: BANNED

replies.author: Mr_Vortex_123
replies.body:
Hello,

I have realised that I have infact had this server before however it was called Nebula. This is why I did not think that I have been on the server before. I remember that I did infact advertise but I am very sorry for it. Over a year has passed and I think that I have served my punishment. I would dearly appreciate is you would pardon me and allow me back on the server as I enjoyed it a great deal. I promise to never advertise again, it was stupid of me. I hope you accept my apology.

Thanks a lot

Mr_Vortex_123
